subject: Junior Draftsperson / Estimator application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi Dynamic Steelform,

I'm applying for the Junior Draftsperson / Estimator role in Forrestdale advertised on SEEK.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, where I prepared and reviewed drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D for road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design, and put together cost estimates and bills of quantities. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, reading structural and architectural drawings, tracking materials and writing progress reports. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027. I'm based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to Perth.

Your advert welcomes people who have recently finished their studies, and learning steel framing from drawing to factory is the kind of start I want. My drafting and estimating so far is coursework, not paid work.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

letter.company_line: Dynamic Steelform manufactures steel wall framing, roof trusses and purlins at its Forrestdale factory for residential, commercial and industrial builds.
letter.subject: Application for Junior Draftsperson / Estimator, Forrestdale
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Draftsperson / Estimator role in your Steel Framing team at Forrestdale, advertised on SEEK. Your advert says you will consider people who have recently completed their studies, and I finished mine in February 2026.

My Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage. I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, and coursework included cost estimates and bills of quantities. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked work against project requirements, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared site reports, material records and progress reports.

My drafting and estimating so far is coursework rather than paid work, and steel framing and estimating software are new to me, so the training you describe is a big part of why I am applying. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027, and I am open to discussing relocation from Melton to Perth.
Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
